hooks.name: Append the Dec 4 Step 0 scorecard to docs/SCORECARD.md at Stop
hooks.description: Runs node scripts/scorecard.mjs --log: one timestamped summary line per Stop, network bounded under 60 s. It always exits 0 and writes nothing when re-entered (SCORECARD_ACTIVE set or stop_hook_active in the event), so it never blocks or loops a Stop. The release gate's Stop hook in contest-gates.json is separate and unchanged.
